Deploy to Downtown Siege

Fight across a bright downtown block with multi-story buildings, stairwells, rooftops, catwalks, parked cars, interiors, and long sightlines. Bots spawn near the action and cannot shoot through walls.

Local Multiplayer: Player 1 uses WASD + Mouse + Left Click.
Player 2 uses IJKL to move, Arrow Left/Right to turn, Arrow Up/Down to aim, and Enter to fire.
